Welcome to Positionless Marketing
Do anything. Be everything.
How much more could you and your team get done if you were free from the limitations of fixed marketing positions?
Get a Demo
Get a Demo
Stuck in the marketing assembly line?
Traditional marketing works on an assembly line, where everyone waits for someone else before moving forward. But marketing today must deliver personalized experiences at scale—and it just isn’t fast enough
Cut the line with Positionless Marketing
Give your team the powers to do anything and be everything
Data power
Instantly discover customer insights and segments for precise targeting and hyper-personalization—without depending on engineering.
Creative power
Create assets like copy and visuals instantly for any channel—no waiting for creatives.
Optimization power
Give campaigns and messages the power to optimize themselves through automation of journeys and testing—no analyst needed.
Multichannel marketing visionary, two years in a row
Gartner’s recognition underscores Positionless Marketing as the force moving the industry beyond the assembly line to deliver personalized experiences
Discover Why

Discover
Frequently Asked Questions
01
What is Optimove Engage?
Optimove Engage is an AI-powered customer engagement platform for designing, executing, and optimizing multichannel campaigns. It enables real-time, personalized messaging across email, SMS, push, and web—without the bottlenecks of traditional tools.
02
Does Engage include a Customer Data Platform (CDP)?
Yes. Engage includes embedded CDP functionality that unifies customer data into a single profile, so marketers can activate highly personalized campaigns without separate data tools or heavy technical lift.
03
How does Optimove Engage help my business?
Engage accelerates execution by removing manual processes. Marketers can plan, create, and launch campaigns in minutes while AI decisioning recommends next-best-actions—driving engagement, retention, and customer lifetime value.
04
Can non-technical marketers use Engage effectively?
Absolutely. Engage is built for marketers: an intuitive UI, AI-assisted recommendations, and drag-and-drop workflows enable sophisticated campaigns with no coding or data-science expertise required.
05
What channels does Engage support?
Native support for email, SMS, push notifications, and web personalization, plus easy integrations to additional channels—ensuring consistent cross-channel experiences.
06
How much does Optimove Engage cost?
Optimove Engage is priced based on message volume and channel usage. Whether you’re activating campaigns through email, SMS, mobile push, or web, pricing aligns to your communication scale and engagement goals. There are no user limits, and pricing supports growing teams and dynamic marketing needs.
